summary: Iteration 174 — Webstore Owner Stripe Connect Buttons: Full backend + frontend testing. Fixed bug: getWebstoreOwnerStatus and sendWebstoreOwnerInvite were missing from AppContext (caused TypeError). Both are now present in AppContext.js and properly exported. All 10 acceptance criteria verified.

minor.issue: SendGrid returns 401 Unauthorized in test env (bad API key), causing 502. Error toast shows raw 'HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized' — not user-friendly, but NOT silent. Functional behavior is correct.

design_issues.screen: Owner Stripe Connection card — invite error toast
issues: Error toast shows raw SendGrid 401 message 'HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized' instead of a user-friendly message like 'Email delivery failed. Check your SendGrid configuration.' Minor UX issue — not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.js lines 709-721: getWebstoreOwnerStatus and sendWebstoreOwnerInvite correctly defined and exported in context value (line 824). Fix is complete.
WebstoreOwnerConnectCard.js line 26: Destructures { getWebstoreOwnerStatus, sendWebstoreOwnerInvite } from useApp() — now matches AppContext exactly. No more TypeError at runtime.

Backend invite/quick endpoint (line 276): When SendGrid fails, throws HTTPException(502) instead of returning {success: false}. The frontend's else branch (result.success === false) is dead code — error always goes through catch block. Functionally correct (toast appears), but the success=false fallback code in WebstoreOwnerConnectCard.js (lines 85-97) will never be reached. Not a bug, but worth noting.
owner-status endpoint correctly maps owner_stripe_charges_enabled → charges_enabled, owner_stripe_payouts_enabled → payouts_enabled. Frontend field names match backend response exactly.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing test store fc0bad7e-9040-477e-93b9-a3f0b1a2df90 (Preview Storefront QA, business type, has owner_email=p4inv-1779644151@example.com, no Stripe account).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner Stripe Connect card is in /webstores → click Settings icon (data-testid=view-store-{id}) → store-detail-dialog opens → Dashboard tab (default) → scroll down to see 'Owner Stripe Connection' card. The store-row clicking does NOT open the dialog; only the Settings gear icon (view-store-{id}) does. Test store fc0bad7e-9040-477e-93b9-a3f0b1a2df90 has no Stripe account (Not Connected state). Connected/Pending badges could not be UI-tested (no Stripe accounts in test env). SendGrid returns 401 in test env — invite always fails with error toast showing 'HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized'.

acceptance_criteria_results.2_check_status_btn_calls_owner_status_ap: PASS — check-stripe-status-btn clicked, owner-status API called (200 response), no errors
acceptance_criteria_results.3_badge_not_connected_after_check: PASS — Badge shows 'Not Connected' (gray) after Check Status on test store with no Stripe account
acceptance_criteria_results.4_check_status_btn_disappears_after_load: PASS — check-stripe-status-btn correctly hidden once status!=null
acceptance_criteria_results.5_refresh_btn_triggers_status_refresh: PASS — refresh-owner-stripe-status-btn found and clickable, badge remains 'Not Connected'
acceptance_criteria_results.7_error_toast_on_sendgrid_failure: PASS — Error toast appeared: 'HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized' (backend 502 from SendGrid). NOT silent.
acceptance_criteria_results.9_pending_badge_amber: CODE VERIFIED (not UI-tested) — isPending = Boolean(owner_stripe_account_id && !charges_enabled) → renders amber badge. No store in env with partial Stripe state.
acceptance_criteria_results.10_connected_badge_green: CODE VERIFIED (not UI-tested) — isConnected = Boolean(charges_enabled) → renders green badge. No connected Stripe account in test env.

mocked_apis_in_use.Stripe Connect: MOCKED — Stripe Connect not used during invite flow (only needed when owner clicks onboarding link). Invite endpoint creates a magic link token and emails it.
